paintings-missing-creator-contribution-s: On Wikidata, add this statement: creator (P170). Fill it with the painter's name/QID.
paintings-missing-creator-contribution-d: This painting doesn't have a creator (P170) statement. Add it and fill it with the painter's name, linking to their Wikidata item if one exists, or create a new item if it doesn't. Source it from the collection's catalog entry or the artwork itself.
paintings-missing-material-contribution-: On Wikidata, add this statement: material used (P186). Fill it with the material(s) used.
This painting doesn't have a material used (P186) statement, e.g. oil paint, canvas, tempera. Add it and fill it with the material(s) used, sourced from the collection's catalog entry.
paintings-missing-inception-contribution: On Wikidata, add this statement: inception (P571). Fill it with the creation date.
This painting doesn't have an inception (P571) statement. Add it and fill it with the year, or a more precise date if known, sourced from the collection's catalog or the artwork itself.
paintings-missing-genre-contribution-sum: On Wikidata, add this statement: genre (P136). Fill it with the painting's genre.
paintings-missing-genre-contribution-det: This painting doesn't have a genre (P136) statement, e.g. portrait, landscape, still life. Add it and fill it with the genre based on the subject matter of the painting.
paintings-missing-collection-contributio: On Wikidata, add this statement: collection (P195). Fill it with the holding institution.

This painting doesn't have a collection (P195) statement — the museum or institution that holds the work. Add it and fill it with the holding institution, sourced from the artwork's provenance or the institution's own catalog.
music-missing-publication-date-label: Musical releases with missing publication date (P577)
music-missing-publication-date-contribut: On Wikidata, add this statement: publication date (P577). Fill it with the release date.
This release doesn't have a publication date (P577) statement. Add it and fill it with the release date, sourced from the label's official release info or a discography database.
music-missing-record-label-label: Musical releases with missing record label (P264)
music-missing-record-label-contribution-: On Wikidata, add this statement: record label (P264). Fill it with the releasing label.
This release doesn't have a record label (P264) statement. Add it and fill it with the label that released it, sourced from the release's official credits or a discography database.
music-missing-language-label: Musical releases with missing language of work or name (P407)
music-missing-language-contribution-summ: On Wikidata, add this statement: language of work or name (P407). Fill it with the release's language.
music-missing-language-contribution-deta: This release doesn't have a language of work or name (P407) statement. Add it and fill it with the primary language the release is performed or sung in.
music-missing-title-contribution-summary: On Wikidata, add this statement: title (P1476). Fill it with the release's official title.
music-missing-title-contribution-details: This release doesn't have a title (P1476) statement. Add it and fill it with the official title, sourced from the release's packaging or official listing.
music-missing-performer-contribution-sum: On Wikidata, add this statement: performer (P175). Fill it with the performer's name/QID.
music-missing-performer-contribution-det: This release doesn't have a performer (P175) statement. Add it and fill it with the performer, linking to their Wikidata item if one exists, or create a new item if it doesn't.
podcasts-missing-language-label: Podcasts with missing language of work or name (P407)
podcasts-missing-language-contribution-s: On Wikidata, add this statement: language of work or name (P407). Fill it with the podcast's language.
podcasts-missing-language-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a language of work or name (P407) statement. Add it and fill it with the primary language the podcast is spoken in.
podcasts-missing-genre-contribution-summ: On Wikidata, add this statement: genre (P136). Fill it with the podcast's genre.
podcasts-missing-genre-contribution-deta: This podcast doesn't have a genre (P136) statement. Add it and fill it with the genre that best describes the podcast's content, e.g. true crime, comedy, interview.
podcasts-missing-publication-date-contri: On Wikidata, add this statement: publication date (P577). Fill it with the first publication date.
This podcast doesn't have a publication date (P577) statement. Add it and fill it with the date the podcast (or its first episode) was published, sourced from the hosting platform.
podcasts-missing-presenter-contribution-: On Wikidata, add this statement: presenter (P371). Fill it with the host's name/QID.
This podcast doesn't have a presenter (P371) statement. Add it and fill it with the host, linking to their Wikidata item if one exists, or create a new item if it doesn't.
podcasts-missing-producer-contribution-s: On Wikidata, add this statement: producer (P162). Fill it with the producer's name/QID.
podcasts-missing-producer-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a producer (P162) statement. Add it and fill it with the producer, sourced from the podcast's official credits.
podcasts-missing-production-company-cont: On Wikidata, add this statement: production company (P272). Fill it with the studio/network.
This podcast doesn't have a production company (P272) statement. Add it and fill it with the studio or network that produces the podcast.
podcasts-missing-official-website-contri: On Wikidata, add this statement: official website (P856). Fill it with the podcast's site URL.
This podcast doesn't have an official website (P856) statement. Add it and fill it with the site URL, if the podcast has one.
podcasts-missing-feed-url-label: Podcasts with missing web feed URL (P1019)
podcasts-missing-feed-url-contribution-s: On Wikidata, add this statement: web feed URL (P1019). Fill it with the RSS feed URL.
podcasts-missing-feed-url-contribution-d: This podcast doesn't have a web feed URL (P1019) statement. Add it and fill it with the RSS feed URL, sourced from the podcast's official site or hosting platform.
